- **self**: Lag-selection multiplicity (7/2)

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] In the Novelli et al. hierarchy, maximum-statistic control concerns candidate selection for an individual target, while an additional omnibus/FDR layer combines targets. The authors explicitly distinguish this hierarchy from correction across all links: a stronger link can be pruned if its target fails the omnibus test while a weaker link into another target survives. Consequently these error-control families should not be described as interchangeable. (low confidence) — https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6663300/ · keywords: Lag-selection multiplicity

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Searching candidate lags and then testing the selected lag as though it were fixed creates a multiplicity problem. Include lag selection in the inferential procedure rather than reporting an unadjusted selected-lag test. (high confidence) — https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6663300/ · keywords: Lag-selection multiplicity · also: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11398661/

## Facts and statements

- [statement] A maximum-statistic test mirrors candidate selection: calculate the maximum across candidate surrogate statistics in each surrogate realization, then compare the observed selected maximum against that distribution. The IDTxl paper describes this procedure and its pinned implementation constructs a surrogate table and tests against its maxima. (high confidence) — https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6663300/ · keywords: Lag-selection multiplicity · also: https://github.com/pwollstadt/IDTxl/blob/master/idtxl/stats.py
- [statement] The multi-lag truncated time-shift procedure tests a specified set of candidate lags and applies Bonferroni correction: each lag uses the overall significance level divided by the number of tested lags. The authors state that this preserves the validity of the procedure. (medium confidence) — https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11398661/ · keywords: Lag-selection multiplicity · also: https://www.mdpi.com/2227-7390/14/9/1501
- [statement] A broader lag range has a cost in the multi-lag truncated time-shift procedure: Bonferroni correction increases the minimum truncation radius, and longer time series may be needed. Restricting the search range with prior knowledge therefore has practical value within this procedure. (low confidence) — https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11398661/ · keywords: Lag-selection multiplicity
- [statement] For the truncated time-shift test, a lag may be chosen from a mechanistic hypothesis or independent pilot data. Selecting the preshift from the same observations and applying the ordinary fixed-lag test is specifically discouraged by the authors. (low confidence) — https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11398661/ · keywords: Lag-selection multiplicity
- [statement] Choose the permutation budget to resolve the multiplicity-adjusted significance threshold. The filtering-and-downsampling study explicitly links the minimum attainable p-value to the number of permutations and statistical comparisons; the pinned IDTxl implementation floors a zero empirical tail fraction at the reciprocal of the surrogate count and uses a strict p-value threshold. (high confidence) — https://journals.plos.org/plosone/article?id=10.1371%2Fjournal.pone.0188210 · keywords: Lag-selection multiplicity · also: https://github.com/pwollstadt/IDTxl/blob/master/idtxl/stats.py
